rationale: Paths kept out of the curated public GitHub mirror (mirror: curated, #1631/#1594). GitLab stays the full private repo; scripts/github-export.mjs builds one snapshot commit without these paths, and check-owner-leakage.mjs --public-export fails if any of them survives. Each path is an exact file or a directory prefix ending in '/'; no globs.

exclude.reason: Audit reports may quote third-party and employer material that is not ours to publish.
Per-user peer preference cards; host-local working data, not product source.
Private knowledge-vault registration; meaningful only to the owner's vault tooling.
Session handover notes; internal working state.
Internal execution plans; working documents, not documentation.
Internal proposals; working documents, not documentation.
Internal product requirement documents (plan-default-visibility: internal); they describe private repositories and fleet state.
Internal sunset reviews; working documents, not documentation.
Campaign working material; not part of the published plugin.
